huddle.headersHelper: h=$HUDDLE_DATA_HOME; if [ -z "$h" ]; then h=$XDG_DATA_HOME; if [ -n "$h" ]; then h=$h/huddle; else h=$HOME/.local/share/huddle; fi; fi; "$h/bin/huddle" mcp headers </dev/null || { echo 'huddle: no MCP token from the huddle binary; run /huddle:update, then reconnect huddle in /mcp' >&2; exit 1; }
